semantics: Actual published valid non-stop Trajectory messages, not unselected search candidates.
Wall points are the recorded public HdMap static_obstacles, source-backed dense occupied samples including 0.4m padding.
Overlap is against vehicle body 4.635x1.892m; extra configured 0.5m margin is counted separately.
Negative signed clearance means a sampled map wall point lies within the planned vehicle footprint; static physical alignment remains unverified.
Each wall overlap requires |wall sample z - path point z| <=1.5m; source wall top/bottom heights are absent, so this is a height gate rather than verified 3D wall geometry.
Clearances above 2m are clipped; negative footprint overlap values are calculated against all nearby height-compatible samples.
Raw LiDAR/map-wall proximity is an XY band count, not proof that every band return is a wall; painted semantic scores were not recorded.
Localization-invalid paths are counted separately; LOST tail drift is not evidence of physical wall crossing.
